# Azamat Klaviatura

> Azamat Klaviatura is a free Windows 10/11 program that automatically converts Uzbek Latin text to the new Uzbek alphabet while you type: o' → ö, g' → ğ, sh → ş, ch → ç. It works in any app — Telegram, Microsoft Word, web browsers, Notepad — and runs quietly in the system tray.

- Website: https://azamat-klaviatura.vercel.app/
- Download (Windows 10/11 installer, Setup.exe): https://github.com/Azamat-Raximov/azamat-klaviatura/releases/download/1.0/Setup.exe
- Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=svgKiBKf1m0
- Price: free
- Platform: Windows 10, Windows 11
- Languages of the website: Uzbek (default), English, Russian

## Features

- Runs quietly in the system tray without getting in your way
- Works anywhere: Telegram, Word, browsers, Notepad
- Automatically converts o' → ö, g' → ğ, sh → ş, ch → ç as you type
- Capital letters become Ö, Ğ, Ş, Ç accordingly
- Understands every apostrophe type: ' ` ’ ʻ
- Smart memory: keeps converting correctly even after you fix a typo with Backspace
- Never breaks Russian words when typing on a Cyrillic keyboard
- Pause or resume anytime from the tray menu in the bottom-right corner
- Starts automatically when the computer turns on

## How to install

1. Download Setup.exe from the website.
2. Run the installer on Windows 10 or 11.
3. Start typing in any app — the conversion happens automatically. Use the tray icon to pause or resume.

## O'zbekcha

Azamat Klaviatura — yangi alifboda yozishni osonlashtiradigan bepul Windows dasturi. Telegram, Word, brauzer yoki bloknot — qayerda yozmang, matningizni bir zumda yangi alifboga almashtiradi: o' → ö, g' → ğ, sh → ş, ch → ç. Katta harflar ham Ö, Ğ, Ş, Ç ga aylanadi. Orqa fonda (tray rejimida) jimgina ishlaydi, kompyuter yoqilganda avtomatik ishga tushadi, kirill klaviaturada ruscha so'zlarni buzmaydi.

## Русский

Azamat Klaviatura — бесплатная программа для Windows 10/11, которая автоматически переводит текст на новый узбекский алфавит при наборе: o' → ö, g' → ğ, sh → ş, ch → ç. Работает в Telegram, Word, браузере и блокноте, тихо сидит в системном трее, запускается вместе с Windows и не портит русские слова при наборе на кириллице.
